name: chat
description: Human chat interface. Provides a web UI where users can type messages that get published to the network, and see responses from other nodes.

incoming_message.description: Text from another node (typically the brain or a bridge) to display in the chat UI.

reset_signal.description: Forget the current conversation — wipes the visible buffer in this chat instance. Published by the New-chat button on any chat-aware node.

outgoing_message.description: Text the human user typed in the chat UI, published for the brain and any bridge to react to.

reset_broadcast.description: Cross-channel reset signal — fired when the user clicks the New-chat button so every other chat-aware node wipes its short-term context too.
